हुङ्कृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Uttered or pronounced as an incantation.
 n.
(-तं)
 1. An incantation.
 2. The roar or grunt of the wild boar.
 3.
Any roar.
 E. हुम् a mystical monosyllable, and कृत made.

हूङ्कार m. (-रः)
 1. Uttering the sound “Hum.” 2. Uttering a menacing
sound, roaring: see हुङ्कार.
 E. हूम्, कार making.
